deviations.claim_in_article: “They were enjoying the convenience of AI, only to find a human on the other end of the call without realizing it. That was what was happening behind the scenes.”
deviations.issue: The article presents users’ actual unawareness of the human callers as something that happened. The Ledger supports that the test began without proper disclosure, but does not establish that users in fact failed to realize a human was speaking.
deviations.explanation: It turns the absence of proper disclosure into an unverified claim about users’ actual awareness; this adds a concrete fact and strengthens certainty.
deviations.qualifier_text: Nearby: “might think,” “in some cases,” and “if this was not properly explained.” These limit the surrounding discussion but do not establish that users actually failed to realize a human was speaking.
